title: Default and close-out are distinct immutable legal steps
summary: Default notice, cure, uncured assessment, early termination, original close-out determination, dispute, independent resolution, finalization and settlement are separate facts. Later evidence never edits earlier legal history.
invariants: Only the non-defaulting party may elect early termination after uncured default.
Original close-out determination remains immutable even when disputed.
Dispute resolution is separate evidence and finalization becomes settlement/accounting authority.
VMM hedge-unwind P&L cannot be inserted into the client legal close-out merely because VMM hedged badly.

provenance.claim: Default, immutable determination, dispute/finalization and close-out legal boundaries.
